items.title: Nike Is No Longer a Growth Story. Is It a Dividend Story Yet?
items.summary: Nike's stock has shed nearly half its value in a year, and suddenly the swoosh is flashing a yield income investors cannot ignore. But a fat dividend built on a collapsing share price is a very different animal from one earned through compounding.
